hooks.command: FILE=$(cat - | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.env|*.env.*|*.credentials*|*id_rsa*|*id_ed25519*|*secrets*) echo '{"decision": "ask", "reason": "Editing sensitive file — confirm?"}' ;; */node_modules/*|*/uv.lock|*/pnpm-lock.yaml|*/package-lock.json) echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Do not edit lock files or node_modules directly."}' ;; esac; exit 0

CMD=$(cat - | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$CMD" in *docker\ system\ prune*|*docker\ rm\ -f*) echo '{"decision": "ask", "reason": "Destructive Docker operation — confirm?"}' ;; *terraform\ apply*) echo '{"decision": "ask", "reason": "Terraform apply — did you review the plan?"}' ;; esac; exit 0

FILE=$(cat - | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.py) ruff format "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.yml|*.yaml) python3 -c "import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1]))" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo '{"warning": "Invalid YAML syntax"}' ;; esac; exit 0
